name: Take Root
description:
Concentration, up to 1 hour.

Your Ward Plant spreads along your limbs, extending roots from your hands and feet that cling to surfaces, objects, and creatures.

You may spend a half action to attach or release these roots. To attach to a creature, roll Spirit vs Dexterity. On a win, the roots take hold.

While attached, you remain firmly adhered. You may spend an action to crush or constrict a creature or object you're attached to, dealing 1d8 + HEART damage.

If a creature attempts to detach the roots, roll Spirit vs Strength. On a win, you remain attached. On a loss, you are detached.

Describe the root growth.
